name: Formbold Free
free_limit: 5 hosted forms, 100 submissions per month, 1 workspace and 1 team member; includes spam filtering, reCAPTCHA, file attachments, webhooks/API and CSV export.
watch_out: Official free plan is marketed for personal projects and experiments; commercial use and free-signup credit card requirements are not explicitly confirmed. Paid Starter increases limits to 3,000 monthly submissions.
